criticalDifferences.finding: Current isolated-position boundary is not an account-wide liquidation oracle; Kraken may liquidate isolated positions when overall Multi-M wallet falls below aggregate requirement
Isolated funding charged to general Multi-M wallet affects broader account safety; simple position-boundary calculation does not fully model multi-position equity evolution
Liquidation trigger uses mark price not manual BTC spot ticker; no official mark streaming or full EMA/index and fallback reconciliation
Historical EEE first-tier 10%/5% documented; class/tier, maker/taker account volume, partial liquidation fees, account configuration may vary and must be revalidated

Locale-specific EEE fees documents have differing indexed last-updated dates and fee schedule references; retain manual fees and request a verified current exact fee tier instead of promoting archived 0.02%/0.05%
Retail/pro classification, market availability and actual exchange UI account context cannot be inferred from the demo or public documentation
Strict piso de stress is a rejected-price scenario boundary, not a guaranteed survival/liquidation stop; failed planned transfers and fee/funding must be considered
A dated 20 October public instrument snapshot cannot be treated as live executable rules on 27 October
